title: Kalibrieren Libre 2, patched App, xdrip >= 20
symptom: User reports that calibration of Libre 2 in xDrip is not possible when deviation is >= 20 mg/dl, leading to false alarms and dangerous situations. Example: xDrip shows 89 mg/dl while blood glucose is 142 mg/dl.
cause: The Libre sensor bottoms out at 40 mg/dl, so calibrating at a high offset could prevent detection of low glucose values, which is dangerous. This behavior has been in place since the Libre 2 integration.
evidence_quote: This never had been possible. The reason behind it is that the Libre bottoms out at 40mg/dl. If the value goes deeper, it would still show 40mg/dl. So if you would calibrate it at +45mg/dl e.g. the lowest value it would be able to show is 85mg/dl Then the user could go hypo - and xDrip would not alarm as it would still have 85mg/dl
